notes: 'whatsoever' given to ὅ τι ἐάν as rule 50 and 72's compression, leaving πᾶν its own `unrepresented` unit; the competing reading, which gives the word to the quantifier, is recorded in the unit note.

κυρίου and πατρί are anarthrous, so their supplied determiners are ordinary helpers on the nouns (rule 51); εὐχαριστοῦντες heads on 'thanks' (rule 91).
